from parsing import parse_bool

def test_parse_bool_variants():
    assert parse_bool('True') is True
    assert parse_bool(' FALSE ') is False

def test_parse_bool_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='not a boolean'):

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='expected string'):

from mathops import factorial

def test_factorial_large_exact():
    assert factorial(20) == 2432902008176640000

def test_factorial_100_ends_with_zeros():
    result = factorial(100)
    assert str(result).endswith('0000000000')
    assert len(str(result)) == 158

import pytest
from buffer import BoundedBuffer

def test_add_within_capacity():
    buf = BoundedBuffer(2)
    buf.add('a')
    buf.add('b')
    assert buf.items == ['a', 'b']

def test_add_beyond_capacity():
    buf = BoundedBuffer(1)
    buf.add('a')
    with pytest.raises(OverflowError, match='buffer full'):
        buf.add('b')
